dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Howard was surrendered into care as a stray, so his past behavior in a home environment is unknown. Howard has been social with handlers and staff during his stay. He was noted to become nervous and head shy during his medical exam. During his assessment, Howard was noted to show signs of potential resource guarding on the toy portion and a low threshold for arousal. He has recently begun leash biting to a concerning degree, which has made taking him on walks difficult to manage. On one occasion, he continued to climb up the lead towards a staff member's hand. Due to these concerns, we recommend that Howard be placed in an adult-only home through a New Hope Rescue partner that can address these challenges with the use of a certified professional trainer that utilizes force-free, reward-based methods only once he has had ample time to decompress and acclimate to a home environment.
dog.name: Howard
